edge_verdicts.reason: 'His first love Jane' is a passing descriptor of a returning character in a jungle adventure plot; the description centers on action, shipwreck and treasure hunting, not a first-love storyline.
'The heat of their passion becomes the ultimate betrayal' is rhetorical: the leads betray family loyalty by loving each other; there is no betrayal-victim storyline of the kind the tag implies.
Zara is 'the daughter of a powerful crime lord' and Damon heir to the rival family that killed her brother; feuding crime families are the stable setting and identity frame of the whole plot.
Lovers from families that 'have been enemies for generations' is the core premise; 'forbidden love' names the main thread.
'He hunted me down, kidnapped me... I woke up tied to our marriage bed' — the husband's kidnapping and captivity of the heroine is a major plot arc requiring a violent rescue, not a passing mention.
The whole story is a marriage destroyed and its aftermath: the Don abandons 'his wife', she fakes her death, he tries to reclaim her; the marriage is the story's premise.
Olivia being 'a celebrity' crying on TV is a one-line attribute; the plot is coma, betrayal and revenge, with no showbiz setting or industry storyline described.
She is a '21世紀的天才醫生，驚才絕豔' and her medical genius powers the 神醫嫡女 storyline; genius doctor is her core identity.
'意外重生，再睜眼卻成了被人欺凌的鎮南侯府大小姐' — the modern doctor's rebirth into the marquis household is the stated premise driving the whole comeback plot.
'公主' occurs only inside the name 鐵扇公主 (Princess Iron Fan's fan offered as a collectible); the book is an urban shop-system story with no princess character or theme.

'Rosie is a college student working in a fast-food restaurant' is a one-line demographic; the described plot is a tycoon romance plus a murder-frame mystery, with no student life or academics shaping the main thread.

Dante 'is now a top corporate lawyer, and a fine one at that', is hired by a law firm and discovers his boss is Hakim; the lawyer identity and legal workplace frame the entire present-day story, though the plot inside it is the romance.
The book is a bully-to-lover love story ('a workplace romance sparks between him, Hakim...'); romance is the main thread, though it is a male-male pairing some 言情 readers may not expect.

The matched span ('perdu ses anciens Alpha et Luna') is backstory, but the title and premise make Olivia the young Alpha's fated mate ('A-t-il déjà trouvé sa compagne ?'), i.e. the pack's Luna-to-be — the arc Luna-tag readers search for.
'許是上天憐憫讓她一朝重生' — killed at her wedding, she wakes reborn as her enemy's brother's bride and relives her life; rebirth is the core premise.
'弄死個人然後就穿越了' and the narrator missing modern appliances — transmigration is the stated premise of the story, thin as the blurb is.
Sara, 'the house's Chef', is household staff preparing the dinner; chef is a secondary character's job, not a theme or protagonist identity.

The entire excerpt is a wife staging a decisive night for her husband ('Two years of their marriage and she always come up with fabulous surprises'), and the title implies the game plays out inside this marriage; the marital relationship is the story's center.
Aria was 'trained to be both a lethal assassin and a nymphomaniac sex doll'; assassin is her core engineered identity in the premise.
She was 'stolen away and groomed by a ruthless mafia lord', and the captor/enemy dynamic stays central; the mafia world is the stable setting.
'She has only one mission: revenge' — avenging her murdered parents is the stated main thread.
'Luna' is simply the heroine's name ('Namaku Luna Croft') in a casino-debt revenge story; there is no werewolf content at all.
'一朝穿越淪落成不能修煉的傻子廢物' — the medical-family heir transmigrating into a trash body is the core premise of the comeback plot.
Her father is 'l'Alpha de notre meute' and her core identity is 'une fille d'Alpha sans loup'; Alpha authority drives the condemnation-and-tribute premise.
'Ta nouvelle Luna' refers to the stepmother's new title in the inciting conflict; the heroine is a wolfless girl sent to the Lycan King, and no Luna arc of her own is described.
The vengeance-driven contract marriage ('casando com Darla sob contrato') is the story's central relationship and plot vehicle.
Dylan marries Darla specifically 'para vingar' his pregnant wife's death; revenge marriage is the core premise and the title.
'Cheia de suspense' appears in promotional blurb language; the described plot is a revenge contract-marriage romance turning from hate to love, not a mystery/suspense-driven story.
Arriving at 'la Universidad de Houston' is the premise and Kaleb is 'la oscuridad que acecha los pasillos del campus'; the university campus is the story's main stage.
Explicitly framed as 'un Dark Romance para lectores maduros'; the possessive love story is the main thread.
Her master's '蚀骨的背叛' — betrayed and killed after loyal service — is the inciting wound the whole rebirth-revenge arc answers; betrayal-then-payback matches the tag's search intent.
'Tanyag na chef' is one item in a list of Maia's hidden talents (jewelry maker, hacker, chef, game designer); cooking never features as a storyline.

'Feeling betrayed' refers to the police not genuinely helping, plus a promo list ('Love, revenge, betrayal, crime, jealousy'); no personal betrayal storyline strong enough to form the tag's expectation is described.
The premise is the parents being 'brutally murdered' and the sisters infiltrating 'the murderers house' for revenge; the crime and its perpetrators are the story's engine.
Vincent, the male lead, is 'o CEO mulherengo' of the wealthy Stewart family; the wealthy-CEO archetype is his core identity in this romance.
Betrayed Valentina 'seeks solace from the forbidden source – The deadly Mafia Lord' to make her betrayers pay; the Mafia Lord is the male lead and the vehicle of the revenge plot.
The match is the line 'I won't regret it tomorrow' — a negated word inside bedroom dialogue; nothing in the description is a regret/追悔 arc.
Cole, 'um CEO', is the male lead who marries Elliana at the altar and publicly backs her; the CEO-groom archetype anchors the romance.
Her husband 'l'Alpha Graham' betrays her and the redoubtable Alpha Logan becomes her pact partner ('deux Alphas se jaugent'); Alpha figures and pack power are the spine of the plot.
'Alpha itu adalah suamiku, Vincent' — the Alpha husband and his abuse of pack power are the core conflict.

The wronged mate is revealed as 'Luna Larasati' commanding the Council Guard, and the stolen 'kartu Pasangan Alpha' (her Luna-mate card) is a pivotal betrayal; her Luna identity is the story's payoff.

'As love ignites, betrayal strikes' is trailer-style phrasing among 'secrets, sabotage, and shattered loyalties'; no specific betrayal storyline is established as the premise, which is a one-night stand and pregnancy.
'It was supposed to be a one-night stand' with the CEO is the inciting premise of the whole plot.
The bombshell 'I'm pregnant, sir' and her fight 'for her child' drive the story; accidental pregnancy is a core premise.
Heitor is 'um playboy irredutível' living by his own rules; the playboy male-lead archetype is his defining identity in the romance.
Heitor is 'o imponente CEO da agência de modelos New Face', 'a personificação do poder'; the powerful CEO male lead anchors the romance.

The tales are 'inspired nonsense — loaded with rhythm, humor, and tongue-twisting names'; humor is a defining characteristic of the work, though it is whimsical children's comedy rather than a comedic novel.
Beyond the matched Oz comparison, the book itself is American fantasy tales — Rootabaga Country with corn fairies, zigzag railroads and a floating Village of Cream Puffs; fantasy is the work's genre.
'智商高達一百八的天才女' — her genius is the stated asset behind 韜光養晦、十倍奉還; a core character identity.
She is '鳳城首富杜府的嫡女' displaced by 姨母鳩佔鵲巢; the 嫡女 identity and the household struggle to reclaim her place are the premise.
'She is an assassin/agents', the feared group leader at school, and the book's own hook asks 'Bakit nga ba naging isang assassin si Mia?'; assassin is the heroine's core identity.

'Ang Ama n'ya ay isang Mafia Boss' is given as the origin of her assassin identity and frames the underworld side of the story, though the scenes shown are school drama; mafia parentage is a stable premise.

Writing the divorce papers and finally signing 'l'acte de divorce avec mon propre sang' is the climactic turn from betrayed wife to rebirth and revenge; divorce is a pivotal thread, exactly what the tag's readers seek.
A framed man must 'prove his innocence or risk going to prison for a crime he didn't commit'; the murder case and its resolution are the entire plot.
'His lawyer Jill Baker is one of the best criminal attorneys' and 'his only chance to walk away acquitted'; the legal defense is the main thread and the lawyer a lead character.

The male lead is a 'Chủ tịch' who cancels board meetings and says the conglomerate can collapse for her — the wealthy chairman/CEO archetype is his stable identity; the forum post's 'CEO giàu có' mirrors the same pairing.
Killed by the 主母, she returns to her twelve-year-old self ('重生之后才明白，从头到尾就是一个阴谋'); rebirth is the core premise of the mystery-revenge plot.
'She's forced into a contract marriage with Leonardo Castelli' — the contract marriage is the story's premise.
The forced marriage relationship and whether duty becomes real love is the central storyline; a marriage-tag reader finding this contract-marriage romance is reasonable.
'一代天才医者带着神秘空间穿越' — the genius-doctor identity is the heroine's core asset as the 医妃.
'替亲妹妹出嫁冲喜的工具人王妃' — marrying in her sister's place is the premise, also self-labeled 替嫁 in the tag line.
The description self-labels '甜宠' in its tag line ('医妃+空间+替嫁+甜宠+男强女更强') and the closing doting banter matches the tone.
'La notte in cui divenne Alpha, mi umiliò davanti a tutti' — Braydon's Alpha power and the Lycan King's counter-authority structure the whole conflict around the wolfless heroine.
The match is the ship name 'H.M. Ships Adventure and Beagle'; the book is Darwin's nonfiction survey journal, not an adventure novel a 冒险 reader would expect.
'太子悔婚，轉賜廢物王爺' — the crown prince appears only as the fiancé who repudiates her; the male lead is the 邪王, so the crown prince is a discarded secondary figure.
'廢柴變天才，懦女變毒女' with 丹毒典 and 通天塔 in hand — the trash-to-genius transformation is the heroine's core arc.
男主 Hiram 被简介定位为 'el CEO joven y apuesto'，契约婚姻+总裁男主是全书稳定前提，符合豪门总裁检索预期。
女主穿越后即成为「護國郡主府不受寵的嫡女」，继母庶妹迫害构成宅斗主线，嫡女身份是核心人设。
「二十一世紀警花蘭若漓穿越了」是全书起始设定，穿越是稳定前提。
「得到皇帝的宠爱，被封为后宫娘娘」并最终成为皇后卷入宫斗，皇帝是女主命运与宫斗主线中的稳定关系人物；但简介重心在女主自身崛起，置信度中等。
太子是贯穿性的主线对手：「再將太子拉下馬！」是女主明确目标，且「陪她與太子暗中博弈」再次出现，非一次性背景提及。
女主父亲是「sang bos mafia」（黑帮老大），她以黑帮之女身份取消婚约另择配偶，黑帮世界构成后续故事的稳定设定。
简介全部内容是男主凝视妻子留下的「les papiers du divorce」等他签字，离婚是开篇核心冲突与全书悬念。
主角被定位为「華夏區第一天才辛陽」，天才身份是其海岛求生与征服主线的核心人设标签。
「一覺醒來，穿越到末日浩劫後的世界」是全书起始稳定前提。
「离婚！」只是简介结尾男主苏醒后的第一句台词式钩子，而书名「隐婚总裁宠不停」暗示婚姻延续；仅凭简介无法判断离婚是否构成主线。
女主是「現世紀的醫學天才」，书名即「神醫醜妃」，医学天才身份直接驱动以身为药引解毒的主线。
「一朝穿越」成醜女嫁瘸子王爺，穿越是全书稳定前提。
「太子长琴」是山海经神话人物的专有名（主角之一的名字），并非宫廷储君设定；点「太子」标签想找东宫权谋的用户看到山海志怪耽美会明显觉得搜错。
「末世的异能大佬」只交代女主穿越前的出身，故事发生在古代农门种田世界而非末世；末世仅是来历背景，不构成检索预期。
「一朝穿越，竟成了小可怜」，穿越到古代农门是全书稳定前提。
「顶级杀手，一朝穿越，成为丞相府的九小姐」是全书起始设定。
整个简介都在黑帮世界内：Fazi 家族、「Princesse de la Mafia」、敌对家族 Capo Lorenzo Moretti；女主与敌对黑帮首领结盟复仇即主线。
简介只是弃坑告示「本作品已经烂尾，请搜索嫡女国师观看」，「嫡女」命中的是另一本书的书名，对本书内容零信息支持。
命中的「supernatural」只是「the supernatural and the human realms collide」的开场泛指，本书是狼人族群战争题材；中文「灵异」标签定义指向鬼怪、通灵、民俗怪谈，狼人奇幻不符合该检索预期。
主角 Claud 是「mountain werewolf」，复活后卷入山地与森林狼人族群之战，狼人是核心设定与主线。
男主 Maurice 是「o CEO」且其双重身份之谜是主线悬念，带娃入职总裁公司重逢是典型豪门总裁文前提。
「haunted by the loss of his first love」（Jemmy）是男主拒绝新感情的核心心结，全书主线即能否放下初恋，初恋构成稳定主题。
男主残忍拒绝深爱他的 Cecile 后「Guilt overwhelmed him」「never meant to hurt her」，书名 Rekindling 指向悔悟挽回弧线；追悔是情感主线方向，但简介只呈现开端，置信度中等。
「一场背叛，一朝重生」——前世夫君与庶妹合谋害死她与儿子，背叛是重生复仇主线的直接起点与全书动机。
「神奇穿越到异世界」并获得三国杀召唤能力，穿越是全书稳定前提。
「第一天才」指把主角拍晕的对手，主角本人并非天才人设；天才只是反派的一次性称谓。
「晕厥醒来发现自己重生……开启了新一次的逆天人生」，重生重来是主线框架。
主角被定位为「一代穿越者古阳」，穿越者身份是其核心人设背景，玄元大陆异世生活即穿越文形态；但简介主推重生逆袭，穿越仅一笔带过，置信度中等。
男主 Dominic 是「a beta of his pack, a werewolf」，狼群职责与寻找 true mate 的压力直接构成主线冲突。
「embarks on a perilous journey to reclaim her birthright, gathering allies and armies」是明确的征途冒险主线段落；但全书重心偏宫廷言情，置信度中等。
开篇即「a tale of love, betrayal, and vengeance」，继母 Queen Eleanor 的暗算与「the treachery that has haunted her family」构成夺位主线的核心冲突。
「falls for her personal guard, a forbidden love that blossoms into a passionate affair」，公主与侍卫的禁恋是核心感情线并直接左右主线抉择（heart vs heritage）。
男主 Sinclair 是「l'alpha des alphas」，女主之父亦是 alpha，Alpha 身份与狼群权力结构是全书核心设定与感情线基础。
命中的「sa mère, la luna」指女主亡母，但女主是 alpha 之女、且被月神定为「l'alpha des alphas」的天命伴侣，luna 概念在狼群权力结构与主线走向中有实质位置；因女主本人成为 luna 未明写，置信度中等。
「穿越到古代名声狼藉的农家女身上」是全书起始稳定前提。
「a morte de Luna, seu verdadeiro amor」中的 Luna 是丈夫真爱的人名，全书是重生婚恋复仇题材，与狼人 Luna 设定毫无关系，纯属人名撞词。
男主目睹妻子公开出轨后「j'ai appelé mon avocat. Ce divorce pour faute…C'était la vraie fin」，离婚是简介的核心行动与全书转折，书名「Mon Ex, Ma Patronne」亦印证离婚后的关系走向。
「靈魂穿越，轉世成為一個沒落貴族」是全书起始稳定前提。
「商界女王離奇穿越，化為農家小女」是全书起始稳定前提。
报恩式「marriage contract」与「The marriage…became a gilded cage that confined Vivian for three years」——这段婚姻的困局、破裂与追悔是全书主线，婚姻题材成立。
「重生之後，她麻溜地悄悄認祖歸宗」，重生后复仇虐渣是全书主线框架。
「一朝重生，虐渣男吊打假千金，做回首富親閨女」，重生是主线框架。
「caught up in a steamy romance with the two brothers」，与两兄弟的情爱纠葛是主线，符合言情检索预期。
「道术宗门」只是收集古镜途经的场所之一，全书是百鬼录、巫蛊苗疆、古镜探秘的灵异志怪题材，简介中无任何修炼境界成长主线，不符合仙侠修真检索预期。
开篇「穿越了」，叶知秋成为贫寒农家女是全书稳定前提。
世界以「突破境界」「閉關苦修」「神兵仙丹」「幽冥魔宗圣女」「天帝」等东方修炼体系为核心规则（真武大陆），符合仙侠修真设定；叙事偏搞笑系统流，置信度中等。
「a sweeping tale of romance」且 Ellie 与 Jack 的感情抉择（「how far she'll go to stand beside the one…」）是主线之一，言情成立。
男主的「supernatural strength」确属核心设定，但本书是神话西部奇幻言情；中文「灵异」标签定义为鬼怪、通灵、风水、民间怪谈类，西部超自然传奇不符合该标签的检索预期。
女主穿越成「尚書府雙腿殘廢的嫡女」，姨娘陷害、庶妹嫉恨、祖母偏心的嫡庶宅斗是核心处境，嫡女身份是稳定人设。
命中的「Romance LGBT」在葡语中既可指「长篇小说」也可指言情；简介正文只讲 Lucy 的跨性别身份认同与自由抗争，未出现任何感情线，仅凭简介无法确认是言情向。
「her husband's first love will come back」是女主婚姻从一开始就注定的核心威胁，Lauren 归来引爆全书主冲突，初恋概念对主线有实质影响。
「the Alpha heir」指配角 Eliana，她只在开场命令 Zero 换装时出现一次，继承人概念与 Zero 的主线无实质关联。
「student ball」只是学院背景中的一场活动，简介主线是 Alpha 与吸血鬼领主的双强争夺与禁忌羁绊，学业与学生成长并未按标签定义持续影响主线。
Seraphiel 是「the cold, beautiful Vampire Lord」，是争夺 Zero 的两大主角之一（「a vampire who wants to possess him」），吸血鬼是核心人物身份。
The male lead is 'the most notorious crime lord in the whole country - a kidnapper, robber, con artist'; the criminal-underworld identity is the stable premise of this captive dark romance.
The description declares the genre 'High school literary romance' and the main thread is the love growing between Purity and Ethan.
Both leads are high school students and the entire arc (school corridors, group work, the writing showcase, school politics) plays out through their student lives.
Opens with 重生後的周沐卿 — the heroine's rebirth is the stable premise that drives her scheming and self-protection arc.
After dying at her scheming junior's hands she is reborn and pursues a 狂热的复仇计划 — revenge is the declared main thread.
'Luna' is simply the heroine's given name (Luna Bexter) in a human marriage-of-convenience romance; there is no werewolf content anywhere in the description.
末世 is only the origin she transmigrates away from in the opening line; the story itself is set in the 1960s countryside, so an apocalypse-seeking reader would feel misled.
背叛 appears only in the male lead's backstory (被前妻背叛) explaining why he distrusts women; the main thread is 1960s family-building with a magic space, not a betrayal plot.
The male lead Nick Sebastian is introduced as the handsome CEO whose fake-lover arrangement with Kania is the premise; the CEO-romance archetype is the core reading expectation.
'heir' refers once to the unborn child ('the woman who murdered his heir'); there is no heir-identity or inheritance storyline.
'I didn't pray for salvation. I prayed for revenge' and returning on the rival's arm 'to burn his house down' — revenge is explicitly the main thread.
The assassin appears only as one case victim ('an assassin run over on the highway') in a list of bizarre crimes; there is no assassin protagonist or assassin-driven thread.
A police procedural: 'a series of bizarre and high-profile crimes' and closing in on a major drug lord's lair are the main plot the leads investigate.
Both leads are criminal investigators (Deputy Commander of the Criminal Investigation Division; a renowned criminal investigation expert) and cracking cases is the main plot.
The 傀儡皇帝 is the male lead with whom the heroine's 爱恨情仇 unfolds — a core character identity in this palace-intrigue romance.
The premise pits the transmigrated villainess against the 重生回来的女主 ('你重生，我穿越'); the reborn heroine-antagonist is a load-bearing premise element, though the protagonist herself is a transmigrator.
The plot is 拐个男主喜当爹 — winning the 王爷男主 as her child's father; the book frames itself squarely as a 言情 romance.
穿越成恶毒女配的白玥瑶 — transmigration into the villainess is the core premise.
The description opens 'Classic adventure novel', and the author context (frontier dime novels, Deerhunter stories) confirms adventure as the genre expectation.
The male lead is 霍氏的继承人 and the power broker of B市 — the conglomerate-heir identity is his core archetype in this CEO romance.
The first marriage collapses on the false accusation 你曾害死了我们的孩子 born of 一场阴谋 — a wrongful-blame misunderstanding drives the plot's central conflict.
She is 'a biological asset designed to merge two crime families' and ends betrothed to the underworld King — the crime-family world is the stable setting.
The only kidnapping is one the mistress 'faked' as a single abuse incident; kidnapping is not a plot thread of the story.
'royal' matches the color of her dress ('wearing royal blue instead of white'), and 'King of this city' is an underworld metaphor; there is no actual royalty.
The title itself is 'C'était trop tard, je regrette' and Regret is listed among the stated parcours of John's sect ordeal — regret is the framing theme of the story.
Ryder Lupei is 'l'Alpha de la meute la plus puissante' (meute de Moon Crest) and the possessive Alpha-and-mate romance is the entire premise.
'a successful lawyer' is one line of family window-dressing; the plot is a blackmail thriller about James's criminal past, with no legal-profession storyline.
The blurb frames the book as 'a tale of redemption' and the plot centers on a man confronting his dark criminal past to protect his family, which matches a redemption arc.
一朝穿越，竟成了遠近聞名的第一醜女 — transmigration is the story's opening premise and launches the whole 逆襲 arc.
The description explicitly builds a romance between Arianna and Alaric where 'an age gap creates an additional layer of complexity' — a stated age-gap love thread between main characters.
Betrayal is named twice as the web the twins must untangle ('deception, betrayal, and political intrigue'; 'question the loyalty of those around them'), making it a central thread of the quest.
The male lead is 'a ruthless mafia boss' and Rose being drawn into his web of sin and obsession is the entire premise.
The heroine is a 女生 and the heartthrob has 整个校园的绝版迷 — the romance plays out in a school setting, matching the campus-setting expectation, though the description is vague.
一场计谋，一场误会。一场失散，让他们的感情越来越远 — the misunderstanding is the stated pivot that drives the couple apart.

"Ma sœur, la future Luna adulée"中 Luna 指陷害女主的姐姐（反派），女主是被夺肾致死的无狼 Omega/真命伴侣，简介中 Luna 并非女主的核心身份或主线。

military 只出现在「When the military arrived...a four-star General snapped a sharp salute」的单一场景，用于铺垫男主隐藏身份；故事是隐藏大佬护卫式言情，不是军旅题材。

命中的「嫡女」指三年后入宫的对手「蕭家正房嫡女」；女主蕭婉是「庶房長女」，与嫡女身份恰好相反，点嫡女标签找到庶女宫斗文会明显错位。
「拯救人类于末世之中」是修辞性口号，故事是7个普通都市男女对抗奇异事件的都市异能文，并无末世废土设定。
「奇幻」出现在「对抗生活中各种光怪陆离的奇幻事件」的形容用法；内容混合妖怪、驱魔、外星人、尖端科技，是都市异能/灵异/科幻杂糅，是否满足奇幻类型检索期待仅凭简介难定。
「秘书溶化，助理爆炸」只是奇异事件清单里的猎奇一笔，秘书既非主角身份也非题材元素。
crime 命中于「innocentant Camille de son crime」的普通词义；故事是婚姻背叛+隐藏股权复仇的言情虐文，虽有谋杀情节但不是犯罪类型小说的检索期待。
Luna 命中的是小三的姓名「le Dr Camille Luna」，全文与狼人毫无关系。
Luna 命中的是 CEO 小女儿的名字「a pequena Luna, que só fala com ela」，这是女贼假扮保姆的都市言情，无任何狼人设定。
「berurusan dengan rival bisnisnya karena one-night-stand saat ia mabuk di nightclub」——一夜情直接触发两条主线之一的闪婚契约，是前提级设定。
「Bir teknoloji imparatorluğunun CEO'su olarak o bir kraldı」——男主是科技帝国 CEO，其身份与权势贯穿整个囚禁/背叛/假死复仇主线。
「一朝穿越,醫毒雙絕的頂級僱傭兵竟成廢柴癡女醜八怪」——穿越是全书开篇前提。
奖学金、剽窃指控、开除、重回「Professor Miller's class」重来一世——全部冲突都发生在学生身份与校园学业场景内，学生身份持续影响主线。
主角虽是「一名大学生...大一新生」，但主线是「深入丛林、翻越大山、进入不见底的海洋」的探险寻宝，学业与校园关系并非核心，学生只是人物背景。
「She has surprising news: she's pregnant」——前女友怀孕登门是全书发动事件，孕期状态在双方联手对抗 Aaron、旧情复燃的过程中构成稳定前提；但简介后半未再展开孕期线，故置信度中等。

「vows to get revenge」指丈夫 Chillingworth 的复仇动机；主角是 Hester，全书核心是罪与耻辱的道德叙事，点复仇标签找到《红字》会明显偏离类型检索意图。

「I'm going to build an Emperor」是比喻——把瘫痪的黑帮丈夫扶成地下世界之王；故事是现代黑帮医女言情，没有皇帝/帝制设定。
「Dès sa sortie de l'hôpital, elle a rédigé la demande de divorce」——离婚是全书转折支点，『离婚+隐藏身份反杀』正是该标签用户要找的故事形态。

「媳婦長大重生了再養一遍」且排雷指南第1条明列「青梅竹馬童養媳，重生」——重生是作者自标的核心设定。
「你居然是和朕一起穿越过来的同学」——皇帝与女扮男装的丞相都是穿越者，这一设定是全书喜剧框架的根基。
「冒险」出现在对世界生活方式的泛述「靠驯服妖魔对战，生活，冒险」；简介主体是训练师学院+系统捕捉稀有妖魔，冒险是否构成主线仅凭简介难判。
「藏锋穿越妖魔世界，获得提示系统」——穿越是开篇核心前提。
「Fille des Alphas Mikhail et Anastasia」「deux Alphas se faisaient face」——Alpha 首领是核心人物层（父亲、敌对首领 Dmitri、其继承人 Viktor），Alpha 权力与血约驱动全书。
命中处是女主名字「Luna, jeune louve-garou de 17 ans」，但她是 Alpha 之女、「princesse de la meute」，且预言指向她与敌对狼族继承人结合——实质就是狼人 Luna 题材的故事空间，检索不违和。
「ódio e amor a linha mais tênue que ja foi traçada」加上自述「Trata-se de uma obra é um romance dark」——爱恨纠缠是主线，暗黑言情定位明确。
法语「l'assassin」意为凶手/杀人犯，此处指连环杀手「le Tueur à la Main Rouge」；中文标签「刺客」指职业刺客原型，语义漂移导致错配。
连环凶杀+警探追凶+「littérature policière」自我定位——典型犯罪/警察程序小说，完全符合犯罪标签检索期待。
「这一世她穿越而来...谁知他也穿梭而来」——双主角穿越是全书前提设定。
「她本是二十一世紀王牌特工，一朝穿越成了將軍府大小姐」——穿越是开篇核心前提。
「一代天才医者带着神秘空间穿越」——天才医者是女主的核心人物身份，医术人设贯穿医妃主线。
「成了替亲妹妹出嫁冲喜的工具人王妃」且自标签明列【替嫁】——替嫁是全书前提。
作者自标签「【医妃+空间+替嫁+甜宠+男强女更强】」明示甜宠定位，结尾王爷宣示独宠的对话与之一致。
「dünyaca ünlü bir holdingin CEO'su maskesini çıkardı. Ortaya çıkan yüz, Sude'nin kocasından başkası değildi」——丈夫隐藏的世界级财团 CEO 身份是全书核心反转与男主身份。
英文 supernatural（「He never believed in a supernatural world」）指狼人/吸血鬼超自然世界，而中文「灵异」定义限定鬼怪、通灵、捉妖、风水、冥婚等怪谈题材；西式狼人命定伴侣文与灵异检索期待错位。
「he is already bound to three immortals. The lycan, Dragon, and Vampire, who is not planning on letting him go」——吸血鬼是三位命定伴侣之一，属核心人物设定。
「he turned into a werewolf during his game」——主角18岁生日变身狼人是全书起点，狼人/lycan 设定贯穿命定伴侣主线。
「卻因族人背叛險些形神俱滅」——族人背叛是主角陨落、残魂夺舍、妖皇归来整个前提的直接成因；但简介极短，背叛后续清算未明示，置信度中等。
「Chồng tôi, CEO Trịnh Đức Thắng」——CEO 丈夫是核心人物，弃妻宠外室、被隐藏身份的女主反杀的豪门总裁式冲突贯穿全书。
「This suspense-filled tale」是宣传性形容词；全书是关于被遗忘的殖民时期作家的历史/传记式文学小说（双时空、殖民史、作者生平），与悬疑类型检索期待明显错位。
「the Underboss of the Fazio crime family」——犯罪家族世界是稳定设定并驱动主线（联姻、投靠敌对家族、火并复仇），对用户选择结果有实质影响。
Underboss 未婚夫、敌对家族 Capo、「I want the Fazio family burned to the ground」——黑帮世界与帮派火并是全书核心设定与主线。
「the perfect, loyal Mafia Princess」是黑帮圈的习语称谓（黑帮千金），并非王室公主；点「公主」标签找到现代黑帮言情会明显错位。
